The workbook states more than one exchange rate: 1.14 (Pricing Inputs); 1.5 (TCO Summary). 1.14 was used to interpret the figures the sheet reports, being the most explicitly stated. Live AWS pricing is quoted in USD and is unaffected.

Estimate is priced in eu-west-1 (Ireland), but the client's stated primary production region is eu-central-1 (Frankfurt); actual primary-region costs will differ from this total, and eu-central-1 rates are typically higher than eu-west-1, so real primary-region spend is likely understated here.

Live-rate total (26772.57) is materially below the client's own modelled figure (33042.56), a variance of roughly 19% in the downward direction — the client's internal model overstates cost relative to current published rates.
A further right-sized scenario (24257.51) is available and sits below the live-rate lift-and-shift total, meaning actual spend could be lower still if right-sizing is adopted.
No AWS Support plan cost is included; actual monthly spend will be higher once a support tier is added.
No EDP or negotiated credits are reflected; if credits are later applied, actual cost will be lower than shown, and if compared against a discounted baseline this estimate overstates cost.

Servers excluded from scope (Windows XP fleet, NOTESMAIL01, SERVIMP, servimp10g-test, checkpoint firewall cluster, and other non-Migration Waves servers) are not priced; if any are ultimately migrated, actual cost will be higher than shown.

SSAGEPeople/SSAGESEI sizing is inferred, not confirmed from discovery data; if actual vCPU differs from the assumed 8 vCPU, priced cost for these instances may understate or overstate actual requirements.

SQL Server consolidation (6 VMs to 4 instances) is flagged by the client as pending DBA validation of per-database IOPS and growth; if consolidation is not fully supported, additional instances or larger sizes may be needed, understating cost.
Managed Services / IMS vendor cost is explicitly excluded from this estimate and is not comparable to the AWS infrastructure total shown.

Cost trend beyond January 2026 is modeled by holding Feb-Dec 2026 flat at the two-month actual average rather than using further real billing data; actual costs may diverge once additional invoices are available.

No data transfer costs beyond the four named Transit Gateway attachments (e.g., NAT gateway, cross-AZ, S3/egress traffic) are itemized as priced; if present in the live-rate figure they are not individually confirmed, and if absent the total understates real network costs.
